headline: As of 2026-09-24: 150,877 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 9 of 50 states, D+39.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 150,877 early/mail ballots cast so far across 9 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+39.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (117,602), Wisconsin (13,449), North Carolina (9,424).
